agent_evaluations.reviewer_notes: This OSCE item is fundamentally unsuitable for radiology interpretation assessment. It contains placeholder content, no actual imaging findings, and lacks the systematic approach required for AMC Clinical Examination imaging stations. The scenario conflates clinical assessment (palliative care goals-of-care discussion) with imaging interpretation. For an imaging station, this should focus on: (1) Echocardiographic findings in advanced HF (severe LV/RV dysfunction, functional MR, pulmonary hypertension), (2) Imaging findings that inform prognosis (biventricular failure, pericardial effusion), (3) Imaging-guided palliative interventions (pericardiocentesis, pleural drainage). The current format does not assess radiology interpretation skills and would not meet RANZCR or AMC standards for imaging competency assessment. Recommend complete redesign with actual echo images/reports and structured interpretation framework.
